name: near-typo-boundaries
description: near_typo needs BOTH keys >= 6 code points and Levenshtein <= 1. 'Nordic'/'Nordik' and 'Quantum'/'Quantom' qualify; 'Google'/'Gogle' (6 vs 5 code points), 'Hooli'/'Hoolie' (5 vs 6) do not; 'Initech'/'Intiech' is a transposition = distance 2 (Levenshtein, not Damerau). Astral CJK keys: six code points (12 UTF-16 units) differing in ONE code point qualify even though both surrogates differ; five code points (10 units) differing in one low surrogate do NOT qualify (length is counted in code points).
